description: Decode a franchise offering before you sign away a decade — the earnings claims and their absence, the territory that is not exclusive, the renewal terms that expire your equity, the mandatory-supplier margins, and the validation calls that reveal what the brochure will not. Use when asked to evaluate a franchise, review an FDD or franchise agreement, is this franchise a good deal, or what to ask existing franchisees. Not legal or financial advice — a franchise lawyer reviews before any signature.
